title: Farm-to-Market
subtitle: Local produce visibility with an explainable stock history
course: COSC444 Database Systems  |  Khalifa University  |  Lab B1  |  Fall 2026-2027
context: An educational UAE local-food prototype using fictional data. Farmers record harvests; markets request produce and confirm what arrives. Administrators maintain reference data.
rules: Forecast is separate from saleable stock.
Every quantity has a unit; no implicit conversion.
Farmers change assigned farms; buyers their own requests.
Available = on hand - reserved; allocation must fit it.
features: Python + Tkinter GUI / MySQL source of truth / BLOB photos survive restart / Read-only LangChain + Gemini answers with SQL and records
advanced: Prioritize expired, near-expiry or currently unallocated lots (defaults: 3 / 7 days). Donate or dispose; record actor, date and reason.
evidence: Observed: 65/65 original suite; follow-up 173 backend, 22 GUI and 7 assistant/read-only checks; 851 diagram checks. Evidence is dated; review pending.
